from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from openpyxl import Workbook, load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Border, Side, Alignment
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import CellIsRule, FormulaRule
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, PieChart, Reference
from openpyxl.chart.label import DataLabelList
from openpyxl.worksheet.table import Table, TableStyleInfo
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

OUT = Path('output/公司季度差旅费用报销统计.xlsx')
OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

navy = '17365D'
blue = '1F4E78'
teal = '008C95'
light_blue = 'D9EAF7'
light_gray = 'F2F4F7'
mid_gray = 'D9E1F2'
red = 'C00000'
orange = 'F4B183'
green = '70AD47'
white = 'FFFFFF'
black = '1F2937'
thin_gray = Side(style='thin', color='D9E1F2')
medium_blue = Side(style='medium', color=navy)

currency_fmt = '¥#,##0.00'
percent_fmt = '0.0%'

records = [
    ('张伟','销售部','上海',1200,1800,600), ('李娜','销售部','杭州',800,1500,500), ('王强','销售部','成都',1500,2100,700), ('赵敏','销售部','深圳',1100,1900,650),
    ('陈晨','市场部','北京',1800,2400,750), ('刘洋','市场部','广州',1300,1800,600), ('杨雪','市场部','厦门',900,1600,550), ('周鹏','市场部','南京',700,1400,500),
    ('孙浩','技术部','西安',1600,2000,650), ('吴倩','技术部','武汉',1000,1700,600), ('郑凯','技术部','深圳',1200,1800,650), ('何静','技术部','重庆',1100,1600,550),
    ('徐磊','客户成功部','青岛',900,1500,500), ('高芳','客户成功部','济南',600,1200,450), ('郭超','客户成功部','杭州',800,1400,500), ('林琳','客户成功部','福州',750,1300,450),
    ('胡明','行政部','天津',500,1100,400), ('蔡莉','行政部','苏州',650,1200,450), ('马超','行政部','宁波',700,1300,450), ('韩雪','行政部','合肥',550,1000,400),
]

departments = [('销售部',22000),('市场部',26000),('技术部',24000),('客户成功部',18000),('行政部',15000)]

wb = Workbook()
ws_dash = wb.active
ws_dash.title = '汇总看板'
ws_detail = wb.create_sheet('报销明细')
ws_budget = wb.create_sheet('部门预算')

# Detail sheet
ws_detail.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws_detail.freeze_panes = 'A2'
headers = ['序号','姓名','部门','出差地','交通','住宿','餐补','合计']
ws_detail.append(headers)
for i, rec in enumerate(records, 1):
    ws_detail.append([i, *rec, f'=SUM(E{i+1}:G{i+1})'])
for c in range(1, 9):
    cell = ws_detail.cell(1,c)
    cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=navy)
    cell.font = Font(color=white, bold=True)
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center')
    cell.border = Border(bottom=medium_blue)
ws_detail.row_dimensions[1].height = 24
for row in ws_detail.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=21, min_col=5, max_col=8):
    for cell in row:
        cell.number_format = currency_fmt
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
for row in ws_detail.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=21, min_col=1, max_col=4):
    for cell in row:
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center' if cell.column in (1,3) else 'left')
# total row
ws_detail.append(['','','','合计', '=SUM(E2:E21)', '=SUM(F2:F21)', '=SUM(G2:G21)', '=SUM(H2:H21)'])
for cell in ws_detail[22]:
    cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=light_blue)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
    cell.border = Border(top=medium_blue)
for c in range(5,9):
    ws_detail.cell(22,c).number_format = currency_fmt
    ws_detail.cell(22,c).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='right')
widths = {'A':8,'B':12,'C':14,'D':12,'E':14,'F':14,'G':14,'H':14}
for col,w in widths.items(): ws_detail.column_dimensions[col].width = w
ref = 'A1:H21'
tab = Table(displayName='报销明细表', ref=ref)
tab.tableStyleInfo = TableStyleInfo(name='TableStyleMedium2', showRowStripes=True, showColumnStripes=False)
ws_detail.add_table(tab)
ws_detail.auto_filter.ref = ref
ws_detail.print_title_rows = '1:1'
ws_detail.page_setup.orientation = 'landscape'
ws_detail.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1

# Budget sheet
ws_budget.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws_budget.freeze_panes = 'A2'
budget_headers = ['部门','季度预算','实际报销','预算余额','使用率','状态']
ws_budget.append(budget_headers)
for r, (dept, budget) in enumerate(departments, 2):
    ws_budget.cell(r,1,dept)
    ws_budget.cell(r,2,budget)
    ws_budget.cell(r,3,f'=SUMIFS(\'报销明细\'!$H$2:$H$21,\'报销明细\'!$C$2:$C$21,A{r})')
    ws_budget.cell(r,4,f'=B{r}-C{r}')
    ws_budget.cell(r,5,f'=IFERROR(C{r}/B{r},0)')
    ws_budget.cell(r,6,f'=IF(E{r}>=1,"超预算",IF(E{r}>=0.8,"关注","正常"))')
for c in range(1,7):
    cell = ws_budget.cell(1,c)
    cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=navy)
    cell.font = Font(color=white, bold=True)
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
    cell.border = Border(bottom=medium_blue)
for r in range(2,7):
    for c in (2,3,4): ws_budget.cell(r,c).number_format = currency_fmt
    ws_budget.cell(r,5).number_format = percent_fmt
    ws_budget.cell(r,6).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
ws_budget.append(['合计','=SUM(B2:B6)','=SUM(C2:C6)','=SUM(D2:D6)','=IFERROR(C7/B7,0)','=IF(E7>=1,"超预算",IF(E7>=0.8,"关注","正常"))'])
for cell in ws_budget[7]:
    cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=light_blue)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=navy)
    cell.border = Border(top=medium_blue)
for c in (2,3,4): ws_budget.cell(7,c).number_format = currency_fmt
ws_budget.cell(7,5).number_format = percent_fmt
for col,w in {'A':16,'B':16,'C':16,'D':16,'E':12,'F':12}.items(): ws_budget.column_dimensions[col].width = w
ws_budget.conditional_formatting.add('E2:E6', CellIsRule(operator='greaterThanOrEqual', formula=['1'], fill=PatternFill('solid', fgColor='F4CCCC'), font=Font(color=red, bold=True)))
ws_budget.conditional_formatting.add('E2:E6', CellIsRule(operator='between', formula=['0.8','0.999999'], fill=PatternFill('solid', fgColor='FCE4D6'), font=Font(color='C65911', bold=True)))
ws_budget.conditional_formatting.add('F2:F6', FormulaRule(formula=['$F2="超预算"'], fill=PatternFill('solid', fgColor='F4CCCC'), font=Font(color=red, bold=True)))
ws_budget.conditional_formatting.add('F2:F6', FormulaRule(formula=['$F2="关注"'], fill=PatternFill('solid', fgColor='FCE4D6'), font=Font(color='C65911', bold=True)))
ws_budget.print_title_rows = '1:1'
ws_budget.page_setup.orientation = 'landscape'
ws_budget.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1

# Dashboard
ws_dash.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
ws_dash.merge_cells('A1:N1')
ws_dash['A1'] = '公司季度差旅费用报销汇总看板'
ws_dash['A1'].fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=navy)
ws_dash['A1'].font = Font(color=white, bold=True, size=18)
ws_dash['A1'].alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left', vertical='center')
ws_dash.row_dimensions[1].height = 34
ws_dash.merge_cells('A2:N2')
ws_dash['A2'] = '报告期间：2025 年第 3 季度  |  币种：人民币（CNY）'
ws_dash['A2'].font = Font(color=blue, italic=True, size=11)
ws_dash['A2'].alignment = Alignment(vertical='center')

kpis = [
    ('总报销额', "='部门预算'!C7", currency_fmt, teal),
    ('总预算', "='部门预算'!B7", currency_fmt, blue),
    ('预算使用率', "='部门预算'!E7", percent_fmt, orange),
    ('报销笔数', "=COUNTA('报销明细'!A2:A21)", '0', green),
    ('平均单笔报销', "=IFERROR('部门预算'!C7/COUNTA('报销明细'!A2:A21),0)", currency_fmt, teal),
    ('超预算部门数', "=COUNTIF('部门预算'!F2:F6,\"超预算\")", '0', red),
]
# use B4/B7 formulas carefully: KPI values in B rows
for idx, (label, formula, fmt, color) in enumerate(kpis):
    col = 1 + (idx % 3) * 4
    row = 4 + (idx // 3) * 3
    ws_dash.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=col, end_row=row, end_column=col+2)
    ws_dash.cell(row,col,label)
    ws_dash.cell(row,col).fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=color)
    ws_dash.cell(row,col).font = Font(color=white, bold=True, size=10)
    ws_dash.cell(row,col).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
    ws_dash.merge_cells(start_row=row+1, start_column=col, end_row=row+1, end_column=col+2)
    ws_dash.cell(row+1,col,formula)
    ws_dash.cell(row+1,col).number_format = fmt
    ws_dash.cell(row+1,col).font = Font(color=black, bold=True, size=16)
    ws_dash.cell(row+1,col).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center')
    for rr in (row,row+1):
        for cc in range(col,col+3):
            ws_dash.cell(rr,cc).border = Border(left=thin_gray,right=thin_gray,top=thin_gray,bottom=thin_gray)

# Dashboard budget execution table
start = 11
ws_dash['A10'] = '部门预算执行'
ws_dash['A10'].font = Font(color=navy, bold=True, size=13)
for c,h in enumerate(budget_headers,1):
    ws_dash.cell(start,c,h)
    ws_dash.cell(start,c).fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=blue)
    ws_dash.cell(start,c).font = Font(color=white, bold=True)
    ws_dash.cell(start,c).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
for r in range(2,8):
    dr = start + r - 1
    for c in range(1,7):
        ws_dash.cell(dr,c, f"='部门预算'!{get_column_letter(c)}{r}")
        ws_dash.cell(dr,c).border = Border(bottom=thin_gray)
        if c in (2,3,4): ws_dash.cell(dr,c).number_format = currency_fmt
        if c == 5: ws_dash.cell(dr,c).number_format = percent_fmt
        if c in (1,6): ws_dash.cell(dr,c).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
ws_dash.conditional_formatting.add(f'E{start+1}:E{start+5}', CellIsRule(operator='greaterThanOrEqual', formula=['1'], fill=PatternFill('solid', fgColor='F4CCCC'), font=Font(color=red, bold=True)))

# chart data area on dashboard, linked to budget and detail summaries
ws_dash['H10'] = '费用构成'
ws_dash['H10'].font = Font(color=navy, bold=True, size=13)
ws_dash['H11'], ws_dash['I11'], ws_dash['J11'] = '费用项','金额','占比'
for cell in ws_dash[11][7:10]:
    cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=blue); cell.font = Font(color=white, bold=True)
for r,(label,col) in enumerate([('交通','E'),('住宿','F'),('餐补','G')],12):
    ws_dash.cell(r,8,label)
    ws_dash.cell(r,9,f"='报销明细'!{col}22")
    ws_dash.cell(r,10,f'=IFERROR(I{r}/SUM($I$12:$I$14),0)')
    ws_dash.cell(r,9).number_format = currency_fmt; ws_dash.cell(r,10).number_format = percent_fmt

# charts
bar = BarChart()
bar.type = 'col'
bar.style = 10
bar.title = '各部门实际报销与预算对比'
bar.y_axis.title = '金额（元）'
bar.x_axis.title = '部门'
data = Reference(ws_dash, min_col=2, max_col=3, min_row=11, max_row=16)
cats = Reference(ws_dash, min_col=1, min_row=12, max_row=16)
bar.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True); bar.set_categories(cats)
bar.height = 7.2; bar.width = 14
bar.legend.position = 'b'
ws_dash.add_chart(bar, 'A20')

pie = PieChart()
pie.title = '交通 / 住宿 / 餐补费用构成'
pie_data = Reference(ws_dash, min_col=9, min_row=11, max_row=14)
pie_labels = Reference(ws_dash, min_col=8, min_row=12, max_row=14)
pie.add_data(pie_data, titles_from_data=True); pie.set_categories(pie_labels)
pie.height = 7.2; pie.width = 10
pie.dataLabels = DataLabelList(); pie.dataLabels.showPercent = True; pie.dataLabels.showLeaderLines = True
ws_dash.add_chart(pie, 'H20')

# ranking table + bar chart
ws_dash['H16'] = '部门报销排名'
ws_dash['H16'].font = Font(color=navy, bold=True, size=13)
ws_dash['H17'], ws_dash['I17'] = '部门','实际报销'
for cell in ws_dash[17][7:9]: cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=blue); cell.font = Font(color=white, bold=True)
# ranking via formulas (LARGE/MATCH) to remain dynamic
for r in range(18,23):
    rank = r - 17
    ws_dash.cell(r,8,f'=INDEX($A$12:$A$16,MATCH(LARGE($C$12:$C$16,{rank}),$C$12:$C$16,0))')
    ws_dash.cell(r,9,f'=LARGE($C$12:$C$16,{rank})')
    ws_dash.cell(r,9).number_format = currency_fmt
rank_chart = BarChart()
rank_chart.type = 'bar'; rank_chart.style = 11; rank_chart.title = '部门报销金额排名'; rank_chart.x_axis.title = '金额（元）'
rank_data = Reference(ws_dash, min_col=9, min_row=17, max_row=22)
rank_cats = Reference(ws_dash, min_col=8, min_row=18, max_row=22)
rank_chart.add_data(rank_data, titles_from_data=True); rank_chart.set_categories(rank_cats)
rank_chart.height = 7.2; rank_chart.width = 10
ws_dash.add_chart(rank_chart, 'H27')

# notes
ws_dash['A36'] = '口径说明'
ws_dash['A36'].font = Font(color=navy, bold=True, size=12)
notes = [
    '1. 报销合计 = 交通 + 住宿 + 餐补，明细与部门预算均可继续编辑。',
    '2. 状态规则：使用率 ≥ 100% 为“超预算”；≥ 80% 为“关注”；其余为“正常”。',
    '3. 看板指标、预算执行表与图表均引用工作簿公式结果；数据更新时间：2025-09-30（占位）。',
]
for i, note in enumerate(notes,37):
    ws_dash.merge_cells(start_row=i, start_column=1, end_row=i, end_column=14)
    ws_dash.cell(i,1,note); ws_dash.cell(i,1).font = Font(color=black, size=10); ws_dash.cell(i,1).alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True)

for col in range(1,15): ws_dash.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(col)].width = 13
for col in ('A','B','C','D','E','F'): ws_dash.column_dimensions[col].width = 14
for col in ('H','I','J'): ws_dash.column_dimensions[col].width = 14
ws_dash.print_area = 'A1:N42'
ws_dash.page_setup.orientation = 'landscape'; ws_dash.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
ws_dash.freeze_panes = 'A10'

# workbook metadata and calc mode
wb.properties.title = '公司季度差旅费用报销统计'
wb.properties.subject = '2025 年第 3 季度差旅费用报销汇总看板'
wb.properties.creator = 'OpenAI'
wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
wb.calculation.calcMode = 'auto'
wb.save(OUT)
print(OUT)
